# Build unique song set and mapping to Title/Artists
song_info = {}

# precedence: song library -> playlist -> show_song (for remaining)
for s in song_lib_songs:
    sid = s.get('song_id')
    if sid is None:
        continue
    title = s.get('title','')
    artists_list = [a.get('name','') for a in s.get('artists',[]) if a.get('name')]
    # preserve order, de-dup names
    seen = set()
    artists_ordered = []
    for an in artists_list:
        if an not in seen:
            artists_ordered.append(an)
            seen.add(an)
    song_info[sid] = {'title': title, 'artists': artists_ordered}

# add playlist songs if missing
for sid, info in playlist_song_details.items():
    if sid in song_info:
        continue
    song_info[sid] = {'title': info.get('title',''), 'artists': info.get('artists', [])}

all_album_song_ids = set(album_song_ids)
all_playlist_song_ids = set(playlist_song_details.keys())
song_lib_song_ids = set([s['song_id'] for s in song_lib_songs])

union_song_ids = song_lib_song_ids | all_album_song_ids | all_playlist_song_ids

print('song_library_count', len(song_lib_songs))
print('album_unique_song_id_count', len(all_album_song_ids))
print('playlist_unique_song_id_count', len(all_playlist_song_ids))
print('union_unique_song_ids', len(union_song_ids))
print('song_info_pre_filling_missing', len(song_info))

missing_song_ids = sorted(list(union_song_ids - set(song_info.keys())))
print('missing_song_ids', len(missing_song_ids))
print('first_missing', missing_song_ids[:10])

# Fetch missing song details
for idx, sid in enumerate(missing_song_ids):
    resp = apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
    title = resp.get('title','')
    artists_list = [a.get('name','') for a in resp.get('artists',[]) if a.get('name')]
    seen = set()
    artists_ordered = []
    for an in artists_list:
        if an not in seen:
            artists_ordered.append(an)
            seen.add(an)
    song_info[sid] = {'title': title, 'artists': artists_ordered}
    if (idx+1) % 10 == 0:
        print('fetched_missing', idx+1)

print('song_info_final', len(song_info))

# Create CSV with headers Title, Artists (artists separated by '|')

def csv_escape(val):
    s = '' if val is None else str(val)
    s = s.replace('"','""')
    if any(c in s for c in [',','\n','\r','"']):
        return '"' + s + '"'
    return s

rows = []
for sid, info in song_info.items():
    title = info.get('title','')
    artists = info.get('artists', [])
    artists_str = '|'.join(artists)
    rows.append((title, artists_str))

# deterministic order: by title then artists_str
rows.sort(key=lambda x: (x[0].lower(), x[1].lower()))

csv_lines = ['Title,Artists']
for title, artists_str in rows:
    csv_lines.append(f"{csv_escape(title)},{csv_escape(artists_str)}")

csv_content = "\n".join(csv_lines) + "\n"

print('csv_line_count_including_header', len(csv_lines))
print('csv_song_records', len(csv_lines)-1)
print('csv_preview_first_3')
for l in csv_lines[:3]:
    print(l)
print('csv_preview_last_2')
for l in csv_lines[-2:]:
    print(l)
